title: Wrong RFC cited for push channel encryption
description: §8.1 says 'encrypted per the Web Push message encryption specification {{RFC8030}}' but RFC 8030 is the Web Push Protocol. The encryption spec is RFC 8291 (Message Encryption for Web Push). The reference must be corrected.
close_reason: Fixed RFC8030 → RFC8291 in §8.1; added RFC8291 to informative references
